brief: Plain single-slope implement shed about 16 ft by 28 ft, framed in wood and skinned entirely in vertical corrugated galvanized steel weathered to a dull blue-grey with rust bloom, the roof also corrugated steel with exposed rafter tails along the high eave. A narrow plank door on the gable end and one small empty square window opening on the long side. Stands in tall weeds and thistles beside a cedar windbreak, wheat and milo fields beyond.
